messages.subject: [pomp-announce] pomp version 0.39-4 released
messages.body_plain:
Dear pomp users,

I've just submitted version pomp 0.39-4 to CRAN.  Source code and binaries should become available on the mirrors over the next 
few days.  This is a minor feature upgrade and bug fix release.  Please see the package NEWS file for details.

All the best,

Aaron

-- 
Aaron A. King, Ph.D.
Ecology & Evolutionary Biology
Mathematics
Center for the Study of Complex Systems
University of Michigan
